requested.meaning: A caller request has been parsed; DSPx has committed no episode-owned effect.

rejected.meaning: Validation failed before local episode allocation; no attempt-start marker exists.

allocated.meaning: DSPx exclusively committed the episode identity and private normalized input snapshot; no attempt-start marker exists.

attempting.meaning: DSPx durably committed attempt start before invoking the generated-program runtime path; provider or other downstream effects may now be indeterminate.

outcome_observed.meaning: The DSPx invocation path returned a value or caught failure, and the exact observation was durably recorded; the evidence bundle is not yet sealed.

evidence_sealed.meaning: DSPx committed one immutable evidence manifest and receipt over all episode-owned evidence bytes after the observed outcome.

indeterminate.meaning: Attempt start or observed outcome cannot be reconciled to one complete sealed episode; the attempt identity is consumed and non-retryable.

closed.meaning: DSPx will perform no further mutation under the attempt identity. Closure claims only episode-owned local state, never provider or external-process cleanup.

allocate_episode.linearization: exclusive no-replace commit of episode identity and private normalized input snapshot

cancel_before_attempt.linearization: durable terminal marker proving attempt-start marker absence

recover_unstarted_allocation.linearization: recovery transaction verifies attempt-start marker absence and commits terminal abandonment

start_attempt.linearization: durable no-replace attempt-start marker committed before generated-program invocation

observe_return.linearization: durable commit of the exact returned output observation

observe_failure.linearization: durable commit of the sanitized caught-failure observation

recover_unknown_attempt.linearization: durable indeterminate marker after an attempt-start marker lacks one valid outcome observation

seal_evidence.linearization: exclusive commit of immutable evidence manifest and receipt after every referenced episode-owned artifact is hash-verified

recover_unsealed_outcome.linearization: durable indeterminate marker when an observed outcome cannot be reconciled to one immutable evidence seal

close_episode.linearization: durable terminal marker after immutable seal verification

invariants: No transition leaves a terminal state.
No operation retries or re-executes a generated program under the same attempt identity.
Every potentially external generated-program invocation is preceded by the durable attempt-start marker.
A receipt is committed only by seal_evidence and only after one durable outcome observation.
Indeterminate consumes the attempt identity and carries no safe-non-start, success, evaluation, cleanup, or retry claim.
Closed claims no provider-call cardinality, provider-internal retry, network isolation, executed model identity, or external process cleanup.
Decision 106 consumes only the immutable sealed evidence projection; it cannot mutate this machine or infer unsupported effects.
